text: The aim of this program is to provide our future international students withthe opportunity to improve your study and language skills before starting anundergraduate program at NUAA.This program provides international students with a pathway to NUAA'Sundergraduate degree. Students interested in beginning their educationalcareer in the spring of 2022 are encouraged to apply. You will spend six monthslearning the basics for your desired degree program together with Chineseimmersion program.
